Import locally downloaded PSID files

Source: R/import-psid.r
processPSID.Rd

Imports PSID data files that the user downloaded manually (as zips, folders, or loose .txt + .sas pairs) into .rda or .rds files named <PREFIX><year><suffix>.<format> (for example FAM2021ER.rda or IND2023ER.rda). These are the names that build.panel expects.

Usage

processPSID(
  inputdir,
  outputdir,
  prefix,
  checkdir = outputdir,
  overwrite = FALSE,
  format = c("rda", "rds"),
  suffix = "ER"
)

Arguments

inputdir

Directory holding the downloaded files.

outputdir

Directory where the imported files are written (created if missing).

prefix

Job prefix, for example "fam" or "ind".

checkdir

Directory checked for already-imported files. Defaults to outputdir.

overwrite

Logical; re-import jobs whose target file already exists.

format

Either "rda" or "rds".

suffix

Name suffix appended after the year.

Value

An invisible data.frame with columns file, status (created, skipped or error) and message.

Details

Output files use the format argument; format = "rds" files are not readable by build.panel in this version, so use the default "rda" when the files are meant for build.panel. Raw PSID files stay wherever the user keeps them; this package never uploads or transmits them. For fam and ind jobs it also writes psid_waves_detected.csv (variable names and years only, no respondent data) into outputdir for waves that are not built in.

See also

build.panel

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
processPSID("path/to/downloaded-psid", "path/to/psid-output", "fam")
} # }
